title: Shiraishi An — Profile Story

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm next!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up?! I'm An Shiraishi from Vivid BAD SQUAD! How are you guys doing? You keeping up with us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're still just getting started!
You're never gonna forget what happens today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's surpass that legendary event together! Surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Good start. That kind of talk usually gets the crowd going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now, I guess I should probably talk about that other thing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sure you guys already know, but our goal is to surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The event that my dad's team, RADder put on... Their very last event...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still vividly remember what happened that night...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The live house was completely packed with locals, and everyone was sweating like crazy as they looked up towards the stage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought I was gonna literally burst with excitement. I felt that I had to shout at the top of my lungs until I lost my voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was when I made my decision...
I was going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
After that, I kept singing...
Then, I found a partner and a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And now, I'm standing here in front of all of you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A lot happened along the way.
Like, a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember feeling sad and so frustrated at times. I even thought about giving up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't regret any of my decisions until now. Not one bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm here today because of everything that happened. I'm a little closer to her now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hope you're watching...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna make your dream come true. We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what lies beyond that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, you better be watching!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it!
How'd I do? Great, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?
Kohane, why are you crying...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You were that moved?
Hehe. Gotcha! I'm glad I went with what I felt!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's really get the crowd going when we do this for real!
